name: 45044 · Middletown, OH
findings: ZIP 45044 (Middletown) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45044 (Middletown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
